forward price.def: The price agreed today for buying an asset on a set future date. For an index it is the spot price grown at the risk-free rate, less dividends, and it is the expected future price under the probabilities that price options.

log contract.def: A payoff equal to the logarithm of the final price of the underlying. A strip of out-of-the-money options weighted by one over the strike squared builds it, and with a daily-rebalanced holding of the underlying it replicates a variance swap.

VIX futures.def: Monthly futures contracts on the VIX, each expiring on a Wednesday 30 days before the monthly SPX options expiration. They are how the VIX is traded, and they can sit far from the index itself.

VIX1D.def: Cboe's index of the implied volatility of S&P 500 options over the next trading day, launched in April 2023. It applies the VIX formula to the nearest-dated options.

VIX9D.def: Cboe's index of the implied volatility of S&P 500 options over the next nine days, the short end of the VIX term structure.
